scope: Read-only review of public one-off wizard, account/auth/dashboard/credit handoff, paid order draft and revision continuation. No deployment, payments, emails, or customer orders initiated by reviewer.

evidence.public: All 7 tests/website scripts passed independently on the final order.html hash; inline JavaScript and website.js syntax checks passed; static asset build passed; git diff --check passed.
evidence.account: membership npm test: 33 passed, 1 optional local artifact skipped, 0 failed; typecheck, lint, and format:check passed independently. Parent reports full account build passed.
evidence.browser: Parent reports focused public navigation, account profile Back/refresh with real metadata, paid-intake same-revision refresh and explicit changed-revision restore passed in local browser fixtures. Reviewer did not repeat these browser runs.

findingsResolved: Late public save-intake and owner-test responses are guarded against wizard/source/package changes; focused close uses replace navigation.
New prepare references cannot silently reuse an older saved source; public drafts are bounded and contain no token, file, or capability.

Auth and account returns are canonicalized to approved account paths; callback origin uses server configuration; credit checkout remains disabled without its server flag and requires an intentional Continue action.
Account board URL state and scoped profile draft survive Back/refresh; auth effect ignores stale StrictMode results; active dashboard requests and checkout requests have cleanup/stale-result guards.

Paid drafts use a hash of the order token as the storage key, bounded schema and TTL, server revision matching, explicit recovery of stale intake/revision text, and review before sending against newer files.

Uncertain revision requests remain blocked after refresh until a fresh status check and a second intentional retry action; newer server marker blocks submission. Earlier saved requests cannot be displaced by opening a blank form.

reactChecklist.hooksAndCleanup: Effects reviewed for dependencies and cleanup: auth cancellation, dashboard page/popstate listeners and timers, board AbortController/request sequencing, checkout timeout and AbortController cleanup.
reactChecklist.stableKeys: Opportunity, alert, tab, country, locale, and source lists use stable identifiers; index keys only appear in static evidence paragraphs.
reactChecklist.accessibility: Forms and navigation use labels, aria-current/pressed/busy/invalid, status or alert regions, and focus handling; revision and handoff notices expose status text.
reactChecklist.draftSchema: Public wizard, paid order, profile, and checkout-intent drafts are tab-scoped and time bounded. Public wizard and paid order drafts omit raw order tokens; the separate 30-minute checkout intent intentionally contains the validated order token needed for the explicit credit Continue action. Profile data is email scoped and size/schema validated.
reactChecklist.clientSecrets: No server API key, Stripe secret, bridge secret, or private environment value was added to client components or public drafts.

residualLimitations: The existing request-revision endpoint has no idempotency key. If a first request completes after the explicit status check, a user-approved retry can still create a second revision. The new UI warns about uncertainty and requires an additional deliberate retry; exactly-once behavior would require a separate backend change.
The optional live crawler artifact test was skipped because its local artifact is absent; checked-in refresh contract tests passed.
No live payment, webhook, email, or production deployment was exercised in this review.
